problem_text:
A logistics company is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: weight 5kg, revenue $41
* Package 2: weight 5kg, revenue $161
* Package 3: weight 12kg, revenue $149
* Package 4: weight 48kg, revenue $134
* Package 5: weight 43kg, revenue $54
* Package 6: weight 7kg, revenue $107
* Package 7: weight 3kg, revenue $165
* Package 8: weight 28kg, revenue $141
* Package 9: weight 6kg, revenue $271
* Package 10: weight 39kg, revenue $26
* Package 11: weight 2kg, revenue $76
* Package 12: weight 43kg, revenue $129
* Package 13: weight 6kg, revenue $227
* Package 14: weight 9kg, revenue $189
* Package 15: weight 5kg, revenue $115
* Package 16: weight 15kg, revenue $252
* Package 17: weight 50kg, revenue $300
* Package 18: weight 6kg, revenue $277
* Package 19: weight 15kg, revenue $270
* Package 20: weight 30kg, revenue $90
* Package 21: weight 30kg, revenue $201
* Package 22: weight 16kg, revenue $81
* Package 23: weight 8kg, revenue $166
* Package 24: weight 32kg, revenue $268
* Package 25: weight 43kg, revenue $40
* Package 26: weight 26kg, revenue $121
* Package 27: weight 28kg, revenue $242
* Package 28: weight 38kg, revenue $74
* Package 29: weight 49kg, revenue $207

The drone has a maximum payload capacity of 452 kg. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
